findings.element: Top-of-card run error banner ('Upload the required file(s)')
findings.finding: The missing-upload error stays on screen, with its stale count, after the user uploads every required file. It only clears on the next Run click.
findings.user_impact: A user who has just fixed the problem still sees 'Upload the required files (2 missing)' next to two uploaded files, so they will think the uploads failed and may redo them or give up.
findings.suggested_fix: Clear or recount the upload error whenever a file is added, removed, or the import method changes, the same way it already clears when a period, integration or account field changes.

evidence.action: Live Chromium: Stripe + clearing, click Set import methods, set Integration Import method to Assisted, click Run, then Browse on both upload zones.
evidence.observed: The error read 'Upload the required files (2 missing)' after the first upload and still after the second, with chips 'Balance_change_from_activity_export.csv' and 'Payouts_export.csv' showing. Clicking Run then started the run and hid the error.

findings.element: Account to reconcile select and Integration select (when files are already uploaded)
findings.finding: Changing the account or the integration silently throws away uploaded files, while the Use automatic retrieval toggle asks for confirmation before clearing the same files.
findings.user_impact: A user who re-picks the account (for example to check another option) loses their uploads with no warning and has to re-export and re-upload. The confirm on the toggle has taught them to expect a warning.
findings.suggested_fix: Show the same 'Uploaded files on this screen will be cleared' confirmation when an account or integration change would discard uploads.

evidence.action: Live Chromium: Stripe + Stripe fees, Browse (chip 'Integration_export_export.csv' appears), then switch Account to Business Checking. Separately: upload a file, then switch Integration to PayPal and back to Stripe.
evidence.observed: No dialog in either case (dialog count 0), and the upload list was empty afterwards. By contrast, Use automatic retrieval with a file uploaded shows the native confirm 'Switch to automatic retrieval? Uploaded files on this screen will be cleared.'

findings.element: Run reconciliation with a required upload missing (Stripe fees / Business Checking)
findings.finding: When Run is blocked by a missing file, the error appears at the top of the card and focus stays on Run, while the only field marked invalid (the drop zone) sits at the bottom edge of the viewport.
findings.user_impact: On a 1440x900 screen the user sees an error but not the field it refers to, unlike the integration/account errors, which move them to the field to fix.
findings.suggested_fix: When the blocker is a missing upload, scroll the first invalid drop zone into view (or put the message next to it) so the error and the fix are seen together.

evidence.action: Live Chromium at 1440x900: Stripe + Stripe fees, click Run without uploading.
evidence.observed: Error 'Upload the required file' at y=92; activeElement = #run; the one .drop.field-invalid starts at y=882 of a 900px viewport; scrollY = 0.

findings.element: Integration side 'Import method *' select for non-clearing Stripe accounts
findings.finding: For Stripe fees and Business Checking, the Integration Import method is a required dropdown with only one option (Manual), so it looks like a choice but offers none.
findings.user_impact: Users open it expecting alternatives (the Accounting card next to it offers Automated/Manual) and find none, which adds a pointless step and doubt about whether something is broken.
findings.suggested_fix: When only one method is available, show it as static text ('Import method: Manual') next to the reason line instead of a single-option select.

evidence.action: Select Integration = mzkt.by (Stripe), Account = Stripe fees (and again with Business Checking).
evidence.observed: Method selects: books 'Automated of [Automated (recommended)/Manual]', integration 'Manual of [Manual]'. The card text shows 'Import method * Manual' under mzkt.by (Stripe).

gaps: PayPal and Shopify: only the default Assisted method was captured; picking Manual and what it asks to upload was never exercised
Stale error check covered the upload banner only; whether the error clears after changing the Accounting or Integration Import method select (a #sources change event) was not separately recorded
Retrieval failure, empty-result and sync-precondition failure states (KF-9) are not implemented, so dead-end error handling after Run cannot be assessed
Where the 'Reconciliation started' status sits relative to the viewport after Run (the Run button is in the header, the status at the bottom of the card) was not measured
